title: Alaska’s ranked choice voting: Six years of experimenting and its biggest test yet
author: Halina Bennet
text: Evening EditionAlaska’s ranked choice voting: Six years of experimenting and its biggest test yetThe system that remade the state’s politics is back on the ballot, and so is a candidate it has both carried and sunk.Halina BennetSep 09, 2026∙ PaidSenator Lisa Murkowski departs from a lunch with Senate Republicans at the U.S. Capitol on August 6, 2026.
